approvals.reason: Pre-lock addition for TV sign-in: a device can now withdraw its own request, which then reads as canceled to the approver. The approvers are the web /activate page, which this change teaches to show canceled, and the silo-apple and silo-android phone approval screens. Whatever a phone makes of the unknown value, approving or denying a canceled request answers 409, so it can't lead to a sign-in; the phone apps get the canceled wording with the TV sign-in client work. The frozen v1 routes report it as denied.

Pre-lock addition for TV sign-in: a device can now withdraw its own request, which then reads as canceled. Only the device that canceled polls it, and it stops polling when it cancels. Existing silo-apple and silo-android device polls treat an unknown status as a failed attempt, which fails closed; the TV sign-in client work shows it properly. The frozen v1 routes report it as denied.
